brief: A personal routine app for one person recovering from burnout: an external memory and a gentle nudge, not a to-do list. It must feel calm, steady and forgiving, and never shame or rush.
criteria: Success: avoids productivity clichés (checkmarks, rockets, clocks, rings, arrows, blue), reads at 16 px and as an Android icon, works in one colour, feels quiet.

concepts.name: Cairn
concepts.idea: Stones stacked one at a time: a trail marker that says you are on the path.
rationale: A cairn marks a route, it does not measure or judge, which matches an app that nudges instead of scoring
Three soft pills with gentle offsets: hand-stacked, calm, not a chart or a staircase
Reads at 16 px and as a one-colour silhouette; a wider-gap cut is used for icons
Moss green and warm sand sit apart from the blue and multicolour productivity category
The wordmark is constructed monoline letters on the same stroke logic, so symbol and name are one system

recommendation: Cairn, in Moss #35665A on white or Sand #F3EEE6, with the Sand cairn on a Moss tile as the Android icon.
next_steps: Drop the Android assets into the Flutter project at milestone M1
Set the tagline in the app's UI font under the stacked lockup on the empty Today screen
Run a trademark search and reverse image search before any public release
